name: Comfort Fincap Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1982, Comfort Fincap Ltd provides loans and trades in capital market[1]
keyPoints:
Registration and Services[1]
Company is registered is a Non-Deposit taking NBFC. It primarily gives loans against securities. It includes loans agains securities for investments in IPOs, ESOPs, convertible bonds or any other purpose.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.70 times its book value
cons: Company has a low return on equity of 8.85% over last 3 years.
